The '''''Tecora''''' was a [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|YV-865 ''Aurore''-class freighter]] used for transporting [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and goods to [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. The ''Tecora'' sported a large cargo hold and could transport creatures the size of a [[Blixus/Legends|Blixus]]. The ship's captain was [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]]. During the [[Battle of Kiros]], it was captured after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] boarded the ship and apprehended Darts D'Nar. The ship was then placed under [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody.

==History==
===Battle of Kiros===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]]. Dooku arrived on the planet with [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] aboard the ''Tecora'' and enforced his 'protection' on the [[Roshti/Legends|governor]] and the people of Kiros.

The ''Tecora'' remained on Kiros when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] landed on the planet and destroyed the droid forces. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] tried to negotiate a surrender with D'Nar, but with no success. D'Nar attempted to flee Kiros on the ship, but was stopped when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] stabbed his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into the right engine. D'nar then engaged in a brief duel with [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], but was quickly defeated and the ''Tecora'' was taken into Republic custody.

===Use by the Republic===
After learning the whole 50,000 [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] population of Kiros was not on the planet, Skywalker, Kenobi, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] infiltrated [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] using the ''Tecora''. The group then went undercover as slavers to find the missing colonists. The plan went south and their true identities were revealed.

After Count Dooku executed [[Queen of Zygerria/Legends|Zygerrian Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] for refusing to kill Skywalker, the latter and Tano used the ship to land at the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Kadavo slave processing facility]]. It was identified as being in Skywalker's possession and was destroyed shortly after landing.
